description: Fetches structured country information (capital, currency, ISO codes, location, calling code, area, etc.) from www.lddgo.net country detail pages.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_country: Fetch details for a country by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (cca3); 参数: cca3, country_name; 必填: cca3
  - get_country_by_name: Fetch details for a country by name, also requires cca3 code; 参数: country_name, cca3; 必填: cca3, country_name

cca3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (3-letter code like 'FRA', 'USA', 'JPN', 'CHN', 'DEU'). Required for both get_country and get_country_by_name functions.

country_name.description: Country name in English (e.g., 'France', 'United States', 'Japan'). Required for get_country_by_name; optional for get_country (improves URL matching if provided).
